newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR TIGHTLY MIXED, MIRRORS NY MOVES.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR TIGHTLY MIXED, MIRRORS NY MOVES.

text.p: White sugar futures responded well to the price movements in the New York raws market but ranges still stayed tight and volume on the light side, traders said on Wednesday.
Trade buying at the lows kept nearby October well supported, offsetting the selling seen from other trade players and commission houses, they said.
The day's volume was concentrated in October and March with second-month December not receiving much attention. Trading in the October/March spread was quiet.
"It's mainly outright stuff," said one trader.
At 1520 GMT October was up 20 cents at $322.50 and December down 40 cents at $319.30. Volume amounted to a modest 1,350 lots.
Market sources said while the New York market had seen locals covering October positions, producers were lurking above the market at 11.60 cents/lb and above.
